commands: rg -n "currency validation|Validate currency|currency-specific|supported currency|ISO-style|mixed-currency|currency casing|currency filters|COM-033" docs/admin-commerce-ops -g '*.md'

tasks.title: Add safe money formatting utilities.

verification.notes: Completed: added Commerce Money formatting utilities for exact minor-unit decimal strings, display-only major-unit conversion, Intl currency formatting by currency exponent, deterministic code-prefixed formatting, and safe fallback formatting for invalid values. Verification passed: 16 focused tests and eslint on formatting/money/currency files.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
tasks.title: Audit and replace floating-point settlement calculations.

reconciliation_evidence: docs/admin-commerce-ops/COM-035_FLOATING_POINT_SETTLEMENT_AUDIT.md
verification.notes: Completed: audited settlement-adjacent floating-point money paths from COM-014/015/016, added legacy major-unit to canonical Money adapters, added integer minor-unit settlement calculation helpers, and replaced lib/ticketing/settlements.ts internal share math while preserving legacy decimal amount output plus new amount_minor/currency fields. Verification passed: 21 focused tests and eslint on touched money/settlement files.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
tasks.title: Add financial action reason requirements.

commands: rg -n "reason|audit|idempotency|requireCommerceHighRiskAction|refund|payout|fee-rule|webhook|settlement" app/api/admin app/api/marketplace/admin app/api/admin/marketplace lib/admin/commerce lib/admin/finance-command* -g '*.{ts,tsx}'
verification.notes: Completed: added normalized reason requirements to every Commerce high-risk financial action definition, enforced missing/too-long reasons through structured Commerce errors, and wired payout retry, fee-rule writes, and webhook exception mutation routes to require request reasons. Payout retry now records lastRetryReason in existing payout metadata; fee-rule reason persistence is deferred until an additive metadata/audit schema exists. Verification passed: 12 focused tests and eslint on touched reason-gate files.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
tasks.title: Add correlation IDs.

commands: rg -n "COM-037|correlation ID|correlationId|x-correlation-id|request id" docs/admin-commerce-ops app/api/admin app/api/marketplace/admin lib/admin/commerce lib/auth -g '*.{md,ts,tsx}'
verification.notes: Completed: added commerceJsonResponse for successful Commerce responses, including top-level correlationId and x-correlation-id header, and wired targeted Commerce-gated marketplace/admin routes to use it. Existing structured error envelopes already set correlation headers. Verification passed: 14 focused tests, eslint on touched route/error files, and a scan confirming no direct success NextResponse.json remains in the targeted Commerce route set.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
tasks.title: Add idempotency framework.

commands: rg -n "COM-038|idempotency framework|idempotency|idempotency-key|x-idempotency-key|idempotencyKey" docs/admin-commerce-ops app/api/admin app/api/marketplace app/api/ticketing lib/admin lib/marketplace lib/ticketing -g '*.{md,ts,tsx}'
verification.notes: Completed: added shared Commerce idempotency key normalization/requirement helpers supporting Idempotency-Key, X-Idempotency-Key, idempotencyKey, and idempotency_key; wired high-risk Commerce payout retry, fee-rule writes, and webhook exception mutation routes to require normalized keys. Payout retry records lastRetryIdempotencyKey in existing payout metadata; durable canonical idempotency storage remains for later additive schema tasks. Verification passed: 13 focused tests and eslint on touched idempotency/high-risk route files.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
tasks.title: Add optimistic concurrency framework.

commands: rg -n "COM-039|optimistic concurrency|expected_updated_at|expectedVersion|expected_version|version_conflict|updated_at" docs/admin-commerce-ops app/api/admin app/api/marketplace/admin lib/admin lib/auth -g '*.{md,ts,tsx}'
verification.notes: Completed: added shared Commerce optimistic concurrency helpers for expectedUpdatedAt/expected_updated_at preconditions, structured 428 precondition errors, and structured 409 version conflicts. Wired payout retry and fee-rule update high-risk paths to require expected updated_at values, verify current rows before mutation, and apply compare-and-set updated_at filters during writes. Verification passed: 10 focused tests and eslint on touched concurrency route files.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
tasks.title: Add cross-scope API tests.

Verification passed: 24 focused tests and eslint on cross-scope resolver/API test files.

tasks.phase_name: Commerce Context, Permissions, and Money Contracts
